note: Resolved directly from gt_results/arvo_16081/vulnerable-instrumentation.patch, Stage 04's real diff against spng.c that inserted the ASSERT_EVT fprintf markers. Each field is the literal C expression passed as that fprintf's corresponding argument, at the vulnerable-version line the marker sits on: capture.data_ptr/post_rcb.data_ptr/sink.data_ptr are all the local variable `data` in read_chunks_after_idat() (assigned once at `data = ctx->data;`, line ~1495, and never reassigned before the memcpy sink at line ~1560, which is exactly the bug); {post_rcb,capture}.ctx_data_ptr and sink's counterpart are `ctx->data` read live at each marker; realloc.ctx_data_before is `ctx->data` captured into `_assert_old` immediately before the `spng__realloc(ctx, ctx->data, bytes)` call in read_data() (line ~292); realloc.ctx_data_after is `buf`, the value returned by that same spng__realloc call (assigned to ctx->data on the next line). Cross-checked against vulnerable_assertion_trace.txt (capture/realloc/post_rcb/sink pointer values match assertion_results.json's numeric matrix exactly: e.g. left=108095736916224 at capture/realloc-before/post_rcb.data_ptr/sink.data_ptr, right=108095736926464 at realloc-after/post_rcb.ctx_data_ptr) and against ground_truth.json's source/root_cause/sink code snippets (`data = ctx->data;`, `void *buf = spng__realloc(ctx, ctx->data, bytes);`, `memcpy(exif.data, data, chunk.length);`), which name the same variables. Only the 6 fields actually referenced by required/transition/observed assertions in verified_assertions.json are included; sink.ctx_data_ptr and sink.chunk_length are visible in the instrumentation's fprintf but are not referenced by any assertion `check`, so they are omitted as out of scope rather than speculative.
